analysis: The candidate ran successfully but did not improve validation HR@10: 0.645, matching the prior gated candidate and remaining below the 0.650 incumbent. Restoring GELU before sigmoid gating therefore showed no measured benefit in this trial; the result does not establish why. The host selected epoch 20 of 40. Retain the incumbent.
code_summary: One causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional tied item embeddings and eight residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block applies LayerNorm, a width-3 causal convolution producing feature and gate channels, GELU(features) × sigmoid(gates), dropout, then LayerNorm and a second causal convolution. Gate weights and biases start at zero; learned per-channel residual scales start at 0.1. Padding masks, position-free embeddings, interfaces, and all hyperparameters remain unchanged; preprocessing, training, and evaluation stay host-owned.
